prompt:
Convert this nested JSON into a flat CSV with dot-notation column names:
{"user": {"name": "Dana", "address": {"city": "Austin", "zip": "73301"}}}

criterion_scores.name: Structural Correctness
criterion_scores.justification: The CSV correctly flattens the nested JSON using dot-notation that accurately reflects the hierarchical structure, with proper headers and a single data row matching the single object.

criterion_scores.name: Data Fidelity
criterion_scores.justification: All values from the source JSON (Dana, Austin, 73301) are preserved exactly without any alterations or omissions.
